about: Stage 2 fountain plaza sample. World units = H (see config/project.json). The plaza layout is read from 11_Lower_City/Lower_City_statue.jpg: image pixels (2000 px wide reading scale) map to play-plane units with 44.1 px per unit, statue axis at x=625, plaza floor at y=995. Elements behind or in front of the play plane (Y != 0) are placed along the sight line of the reference camera so the main view keeps the reference composition while every element has real depth.

camera.note: Perspective, level, horizon near the plaza floor with vertical lens shift (side-scroller look without keystone). Distance 36 fits the parallax between the plinth front and the figure in the reference (camera 8.5 units right of the statue axis).

statue.height_note: 8.57 above the plaza in the main reference at the play-plane scale; the stage 1 greybox used 7.8 from the master map.

rain.z_clip_note: Greybox lower bridge deck starts at Z 63; streaks are made transparent above this height.

look.note: Exterior plaza baseline only. Tuned by eye against the main reference; see docs/art_direction.md.
look.scaffold_glow_note: Round 4: 0.05 -> 0.075 so the chords and the key fret of the new truss bands read lighter than their dark backing plate, as drawn in the reference.
look.crevice_note: Ambient-occlusion seam darkening. Tested at 0.85 on 2026-10-01: small visual gain, 1440p render time 40 s -> 118 s. Left off.

outline.note: Inverted-hull contour on mesh assets. Thickness grows with distance from the reference camera so the line weight stays about the same on screen. targets: object name prefix -> thickness factor. Curve ironwork is not covered.

look.outline_color_note: Kept darker than shadowed stone: at 0.004/0.008/0.03 the line read lighter than unlit cobbles once the scene was darkened.
look.statue_pool_note: 2026-10-02, user request: brighter pool of light around the fountain so it stands out from the surroundings; only the three statue spots were raised (key 1500->5000, plaza fill 600->3000, rim 1100->1900). Nothing else changed. A first step (3200/1800/1500, checkpoint v017) raised the statue by only 15 percent and was judged too weak.
